title: Fennic applies for protective shield proceedings (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. Fennic Railway Brakes GmbH applies for protective shield proceedings. The managing director said: We are confident that the business can be continued and we will keep all customers supplied during the proceedings. The company produces rail brake pads, composite brake blocks and rail brake discs at its plant in Neustadt-Rhein and holds the certifications ISO 9001, ISO/TS 22163 and ISO 14001.
